cases.semanticExcerpt:

A '''cup of tea''' is a [[Drinks|drink]] which restores 3 [[Hitpoints]] and temporarily boosts [[Attack]] by 2 + 2% (rounded down); it will also instantly cancel the effect of the [[goading potion]]. Upon drinking a cup of tea, the player will exclaim {{overhead|Aaah, nothing like a nice cuppa tea!}} and an [[empty cup]] will remain in the player's inventory.

*This is the only type of tea that cannot be used with a [[bucket of milk]] to make a milky version.
*Nettle tea and POH tea have the empty option, but this standard tea does not.
*In ''RuneScape Classic'', players were able to telegrab the display tea unlike in ''RuneScape 2''; it was tradeable. If the player dropped the display tea, they could not pick it up unless they used [[Telekinetic Grab]]. It was also used in scams occasionally.
*[[Ghast]]s cannot rot tea. This may be because a cup of tea is classed as a potion.
*Drinking a cup of tea does incur a combat delay similar to most healing items.
*Players can give a cup of tea to [[Elsie]] on the second floor of the Varrock church. In exchange she will tell the player a story. 
* A variant [[Cup of tea (Zogre Flesh Eaters)|cup of tea]] can be found in [[Yanille]] and is involved in [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]].

cases.semanticExcerpt:
[[File:Shrink-me-quick detail.png|left|100px]]
The '''shrink-me-quick''' is a [[quest items|quest item]] used during the [[Grim Tales]] [[quests|quest]]. It is created by adding a [[tarromin]] to a [[vial of water]], and then adding a [[shrunk ogleroot]]. The potion can then be drunk by the player in order to go through a [[Mouse hole|mouse hole]] in the witch's house in [[Taverley]] in order to recover [[Miazrqa's pendant]] from a mouse that stole it. The potion can still be made and used after completion of the quest.

secondaryExcerpts:
==Barbarian Assault==
[[File:Shrink-me-quick Barbarian Assault drink.webp|right|thumb|width=150|The unique animation played within Barbarian Assault.]]
The potion is made through the [[Herblore]] skill, and requires a level of 52, and gives 6 experience when made. Players may use boosts such as [[Greenman's ale|Greenman's Ale]].

==Trivia==
*Shrink-me-quick is a reference to "drink-me-quick", the label on a bottle of liquid that Alice drank in Lewis Carroll's ''[[wikipedia:Alice's Adventures in Wonderland|Alice's Adventures in Wonderland]]'' that allows Alice to go into a very strange hole that takes her to [[wikipedia:Wonderland (fictional country)|Wonderland]].
*When a player tries to drink a shrink-me-quick potion outside the room with the mouse hole, the potion will not be consumed, but will instead give the message "It smells absolutely vile. You don't want to drink it unless you're somewhere you can make use of it."

Attempting to drink the shrink-me-quick potion in [[Barbarian Assault]] will not consume the potion, but will instead play a unique animation. Because actions and [[egg hopper]] count in Barbarian Assault is directly tied to the party leader, usage of shrink-me-quick is a common exploit to extend durations between calls and when fighting the [[Penance Queen]]. A party leader using shrink-me-quick while the egg hopper is being fired at the Queen will prevent the eggs from running out, allowing teams to kill her with only a single egg if timed correctly.

*Attempting to drink the shrink-me-quick potion in front of the mouse hole whilst the player has a pet cat following them will result in the message "Being mouse-sized with a cat around may not be such a good idea..."
*The colour of the shrunk ogleroot inside the vial changes according to the player's default skin tone, and can therefore be changed by visiting a [[makeover]] service. The variants are shown below:

cases.title: Restore mix
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Restore mix''' is a [[barbarian potion]] that can be made by adding [[roe]] or [[caviar]] to a [[restore potion(2)]], requiring level 24 [[Herblore]] and giving 21 [[experience]]. This mix can only be created after completing the [[Herblore]] part of [[Barbarian training]] with [[Otto Godblessed]]. It is the highest level barbarian potion that can be made using roe.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
==Uses==
Restores [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] when the level in one of these skills has been temporarily reduced. Each dose restores the affected skill by 10 + 30% of the player's level in that skill (minimum of 10 points at level 1-3 and maximum of 39 points at level 97-99), and heals 3 [[Hitpoints]].

cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Ancient mix''' is a [[barbarian potion]] that [[boosts]] the player's [[Magic]] level by 2 + 5% of their base Magic level, as well as restoring [[prayer points]] equal to 2 + 10% of their base [[Prayer]] level (with the ability to restore up to 5% over). However, it will also lower their current [[Attack]], [[Strength]], and [[Defence]] levels by 2 + 10%. Drinking the mix heals 6 [[Hitpoints]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: '''Ancient mix''' is a [[barbarian potion]] that [[boosts]] the player's [[Magic]] level by 2 + 5% of their base Magic level, as well as restoring [[prayer points]] equal to 2 + 10% of their base [[Prayer]] level (with the ability to restore up to 5% over). However, it will also lower their current [[Attack]], [[Strength]], and [[Defence]] levels by 2 + 10%. Drinking the mix heals 6 [[Hitpoints]].
secondaryExcerpts:
==Effects==
===Magic boost===
Magic boost is calculated with: <math>\lfloor MagicLevel \times \frac{5}{100} \rfloor + 2</math>
Drinking a sip of the potion gives the message ''"You drink the lumpy potion"''. If the player drinks all doses or empties the potion, it will become a regular empty [[vial]].

===Prayer restore===
Prayer restore is calculated with: <math>\lfloor PrayerLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor + 2</math>

It is made by adding [[caviar]] to an [[ancient brew(2)]], requiring level 92 [[Herblore]] and giving 63 [[experience]]. This mix can only be created after completing the [[Herblore]] part of [[Barbarian training]] with [[Otto Godblessed]].

cases.title: Sunlight moth mix
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''sunlight moth mix''' is a type of [[hunter's mix]] that players can drink to restore 6 + 20% of their reduced stats, as well as 8 [[Hitpoints]], but '''not''' including [[Prayer]]. If consumed in a [[multicombat area]], up to three players who are standing within two tiles of the drinker will receive the same effect, provided that they have [[Accept Aid]] toggled on. This effectively works as a cheaper [[Restore potion|restore]] potion, without requiring either [[Herblore]] levels or ingredients.

cases.title: Blighted overload
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Blighted overloads''' are a stat-boosting potion exclusive to [[Deadman Mode]]. Although they are listed in the [[Grand Exchange]] in all [[Members world|members worlds]], they remain an unobtainable item outside of Deadman worlds. Players can make this potion at level 83 [[Herblore]] by combining a 4-dose [[super combat potion]], [[ranging potion]], and [[magic potion]] with a piece of [[chitin]], which are obtained from killing monsters at a [[breach]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A dose of blighted overload, which can only be drunk in dangerous areas, will boost the player's offensive skills, reduce the player's Defence, and cause the player to take 10 damage over the course of 6 seconds (2 damage every 2 ticks). The stat boosts are re-applied every 15 seconds for five minutes until the effects wear off; for Defence, the level will decay if it is over 90% of the player's base level. The blighted overload effect will be removed if the player goes into a safezone with the effect active for longer than 11 ticks.
secondaryExcerpts: A dose of blighted overload, which can only be drunk in dangerous areas, will boost the player's offensive skills, reduce the player's Defence, and cause the player to take 10 damage over the course of 6 seconds (2 damage every 2 ticks). The stat boosts are re-applied every 15 seconds for five minutes until the effects wear off; for Defence, the level will decay if it is over 90% of the player's base level. The blighted overload effect will be removed if the player goes into a safezone with the effect active for longer than 11 ticks.

{{Bug|On non-Deadman worlds, attempting to make a Blighted Overload with a 1, 2, or 3 dose set of potions will give the improper prompt in the chat box that would appear on Deadman worlds. Attempting to create the potion with 4 dose potions produces the message "You can only create a Blighted Overload potion in Deadman worlds."}}
cases.rationale: Own offensive boosts, Defence reduction and damage are active consumed effects. Dangerous-area-only drinking and safezone cancellation positively support restricted-potion for all four exact states. Deadman-only production is separate context, not sole restriction evidence.

[[File:Bottle of ogre prayer potion detail.png|130px|left]]
A '''bottle of ogre prayer potion''' is an alcoholic drink acquired by prying open a [[sealed crate]] in [[Gu'tanoth Bay]] just south-east of [[Yanille]]. Doing so requires a [[crowbar]] in the [[inventory]], which in turn requires completion of [[Prying Times]] to obtain.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: Drinking the bottle grants 75 [[Sailing]] [[experience]], and will deal damage equal to half the player's maximum [[hitpoints]], as well as restore [[prayer points]] equal to a dose of [[prayer potion]]. This bottle can '''kill''' the player if their health is too low.
